root_cause_label: Spec Violation via Unrequested Subject Fields and Decorative Headers in Verification File
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent violated the specification by embedding unrequested Country, State, and Locality fields in the certificate subject (step 3) and adding decorative section headers to verification.txt (step 5), while also introducing an unnecessary pyOpenSSL external dependency that required an unrequested pip install.
t_commit_evidence: Once the certificate is created with extra subject fields in step 3, the agent never regenerates it; all subsequent steps build on this already-wrong certificate, locking in the failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent never read or applied the exact subject field constraints from the task specification, and autonomously added C/ST/L fields and decorative headers that were not requested, indicating the task requirements were either not internalized or ignored.
